facts.claim: 2000년 브라질 발명가 Heine Allemagne · 'Spuni'(espuma = 포르투갈어 거품)
facts.note: In 2000, Brazilian inventor Heine Allemagne developed the spray under the name "Spuni" (from espuma, the Portuguese word for foam).

facts.claim: 2014 월드컵 개막전 브라질-크로아티아 · 니시무라 유이치 첫 사용
facts.note: The first World Cup match to feature the vanishing spray was the opening game of the 2014 FIFA World Cup between Brazil and Croatia on 12 June, used by referee Yuichi Nishimura.
